library: single roving Tab stop and enabled-item eligibility
orientation-aware and RTL-aware directional focus movement
consumer: provide an accessible toolbar name when context does not already label it
provide meaningful child control/link names and application actions

notes: Server markup remains progressively usable before client activation; the enhanced client contract establishes one roving Tab stop and retains the last-focused enabled item for re-entry.
